title: Chamber of Deputies Dispatches 2027 Budget to the Senate After 20-Hour Session
detail: In the early hours of November 13 the Chamber of Deputies finished voting the 2027 Budget Law (boletín 18702) after a session of more than 20 hours and sent it to the Senate for its second constitutional stage. The Chamber rejected the items of Interior, Education, Segegob, Mining, Women and Culture and Science; the Culture item failed 59 to 60. Finance Minister Jorge Quiroz said the Senate will restore the rejected items with adjustments. If the Senate changes the text it returns to the Chamber, and a mixed committee can settle remaining differences.
